nodes.description: State variable holding the hard-coded WhaleSharkContract address used for external balance lookups
State variable holding the hard-coded StakingContract address used for external staking lookups
Public view function that sums the number of sharks held and the number of sharks staked for a given address
Address parameter forwarded to both external contract calls
Local variable storing the return value of whaleSharkContract.balanceOf(owner)
Local variable storing the length of stakingContract.getTokensStaked(owner)
External call to the untrusted whaleSharkContract.balanceOf(owner) whose return value is trusted unconditionally
External call to the untrusted stakingContract.getTokensStaked(owner) whose array length is trusted unconditionally
Arithmetic combination numHoldingSharks + numStaked that produces the value returned by balanceOf (checked arithmetic in Solidity 0.8.10)

edges.reason: owner parameter is forwarded as the argument of the external whaleSharkContract.balanceOf call
whaleSharkContract state variable supplies the target address for the external balance lookup
return value of the external balance lookup is assigned to numHoldingSharks
owner parameter is forwarded as the argument of the external stakingContract.getTokensStaked call
stakingContract state variable supplies the target address for the external staking lookup
array length of the external staking lookup result is assigned to numStaked
numHoldingSharks is an operand of the final addition
numStaked is an operand of the final addition
addition result is returned by balanceOf
balanceOf execution reaches the external balance lookup call
balanceOf execution reaches the external staking lookup call
the untrusted whaleSharkContract could re-enter balanceOf while the external balance lookup is in flight
the untrusted stakingContract could re-enter balanceOf while the external staking lookup is in flight

normalization_plan.reason: owner is only a transient argument that is immediately consumed by the external whaleSharkContract.balanceOf call, so it carries no independent state and folds into that core unsafe_operation
numHoldingSharks exists solely to hold the return value of the external balance lookup, so it folds into the producing core unsafe_operation
numStaked exists solely to hold the length of the result of the external staking lookup, so it folds into the producing core unsafe_operation
